name: Professor Salvatore Lorenzo Renne
designation: Team Leader · Associate Professor of Pathological Anatomy
bio: Professor Salvatore Lorenzo Renne is a pathologist in Anatomia Patologica at Humanitas and Associate Professor of Pathological Anatomy at Humanitas University. His clinical and research profile focuses on mesenchymal tumors, including soft tissue sarcomas and GIST, with interests spanning diagnostic pathology and clinicopathological research.
